newsitem.title: UK: Easier UK meals and feeds market in holiday mood.
newsitem.headline: Easier UK meals and feeds market in holiday mood.

text.p: Mostly lower prices on the UK meals and feeds market failed to attract buyers ahead of the holiday weekend on Friday.
The market will be closed on Monday May 5 for a bank holiday and reopens on Tuesday May 6.
"Things are a bit unsettled following the election result and people are taking advantage of the quiet market to slip off early for the holiday weekend," said one broker.
High protein soymeal was one to three stg down in the near months with positions towards the end of the year one to two stg up.
Corn gluten feed pellets were one stg higher.
